question: Can retained package-native paths be placed and visually clipped into regions while preserving surrounding artwork and drawing state?
decision: Evaluate a small placement/visibility adapter before freezing a public API; boundary-dependent integration remains separate.
source_scope: Existing GradientPath2D motivation; requested spatial composition is a new project design need, not an inferred measured range.

cases.meaning: same retained world paths seen through rectangle and ellipse windows
same retained local paths placed separately in both regions
same placed local paths transferred to repeated circle marks
parent artwork only; no regional drawings

acceptance: All outside-region pixels equal control3; existing canvas preserved.
All retained geometry hashes equal across modes and unchanged by draw.
Parent native clip and transform unchanged by child region rendering.
Global versus local compositions visibly differ, and line-to-circle transfer remains visibly restricted by masks.
Native renderer, dimensions, seed, source/JAR and image hashes bound by existing render helper.
limits: Private native hard clipping, not antialiased feathering/portable geometric clipping.
No stop/bounce/wrap behavior, arbitrary operation wrapper, public transform signature or target attestation.
Uniform scale/object-space widths only; mask regions are supplied canvas-space rectangle/ellipse.
